## IDS 702: Final Project FALL 2025

## Statistical Analysis of Election Outcomes in the USA, 2000-2024

## **Economic Data Download**

**Block 1: Load packages**

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(janitor)

cat("✓ Packages loaded\n")
```

**Block 2: Set up API key**

```{r}
# Check if API key is already installed
if(Sys.getenv("CENSUS_API_KEY") == "") {
  # If not, uncomment line below and add your key:
  census_api_key("ac913841c1d40db7500f47ab697722898a0a306a", install = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("⚠ No API key found. Add your key above.\n")
} else {
  cat("✓ Census API key found\n")
}
```

**Block 3: Define economic variables**

```{r}
# Define variables
economic_variables <- c(
  # Income & Poverty
  "median_household_income" = "B19013_001",
  "per_capita_income" = "B19301_001",
  "poverty_total_pop" = "B17001_001",
  "poverty_below_line" = "B17001_002",
  
  # Income Distribution (individual brackets)
  "income_under_10k" = "B19001_002",
  "income_10k_15k" = "B19001_003",
  "income_15k_20k" = "B19001_004",
  "income_20k_25k" = "B19001_005",
  "income_25k_30k" = "B19001_006",
  "income_30k_35k" = "B19001_007",
  "income_35k_40k" = "B19001_008",
  "income_40k_45k" = "B19001_009",
  "income_45k_50k" = "B19001_010",
  "income_50k_60k" = "B19001_011",
  "income_60k_75k" = "B19001_012",
  "income_75k_100k" = "B19001_013",
  "income_100k_125k" = "B19001_014",
  "income_125k_150k" = "B19001_015",
  "income_150k_200k" = "B19001_016",
  "income_200k_plus" = "B19001_017",
  
  # Employment
  "labor_force_total" = "B23025_002",
  "labor_force_employed" = "B23025_004",
  "labor_force_unemployed" = "B23025_005",
  "civilian_pop_16plus" = "B23025_001",
  
  # Housing
  "median_home_value" = "B25077_001",
  "median_gross_rent" = "B25064_001",
  "total_households" = "B25003_001",
  "owner_occupied" = "B25003_002",
  "renter_occupied" = "B25003_003",
  "rent_burden_total" = "B25070_001",
  "rent_burden_30_35pct" = "B25070_007",
  "rent_burden_35_40pct" = "B25070_008",
  "rent_burden_40_50pct" = "B25070_009",
  "rent_burden_50pct_plus" = "B25070_010",
  
  # Education
  "edu_total_25plus" = "B15003_001",
  "edu_less_than_hs" = "B15003_002",
  "edu_high_school" = "B15003_017",
  "edu_some_college" = "B15003_019",
  "edu_associates" = "B15003_021",
  "edu_bachelors" = "B15003_022",
  "edu_masters" = "B15003_023",
  "edu_professional" = "B15003_024",
  "edu_doctorate" = "B15003_025",
  
  # Demographics
  "total_population" = "B01003_001",
  "pop_18_plus" = "B09021_001"
)

# Set years
YEARS_ACS <- 2011:2023
GEOGRAPHY <- "state"

# Download ACS 1-year data
acs_data_list <- map(YEARS_ACS, function(yr) {
  cat(sprintf("Year %d: ", yr))
  
  tryCatch({
    data <- get_acs(
      geography = GEOGRAPHY,
      variables = economic_variables,
      year = yr,
      survey = "acs1",
      output = "wide"
    ) %>%
      mutate(year = yr, .before = 1)
    
    cat(sprintf("✓ %d records\n", nrow(data)))
    return(data)
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("✗ Failed\n")
    return(NULL)
  })
})

# Remove failed years
acs_data_list <- acs_data_list[!sapply(acs_data_list, is.null)]

# Combine all years
census_data_all <- bind_rows(acs_data_list)

# Save to CSV
write_csv(census_data_all, "census_economic_data_raw2.csv")

cat("\n✓ Data saved to census_economic_data_raw2.csv\n")
```
